tex_content.html:
With the preceding notation, \[ \widehat H(|X|^2)=-2\Ric _g(X,X)-2k^2|X|^2, \qquad [\widehat H,S]=(k^2+\Ric _g(S,S))S. \]
Proof

↗ lem:spacetime-christoffel \sketch Since $[\widehat H,X]=0$, differentiate $|X|^2$ using Equation (6). Orthogonality of $H$ and $S$ gives the $-2k^2|X|^2$ term. Differentiate $S=|X|^{-1}X$ and substitute the first identity.

□

Lemma
[Evolution equation for the curvature $k^2$]

\label{1stcurvshr}


With the preceding notation,
\[
\widehat H(|X|^2)=-2\Ric_g(X,X)-2k^2|X|^2,
\qquad
[\widehat H,S]=(k^2+\Ric_g(S,S))S.
\]
\end{lemma}
